label: RUCKUS ICX 7150-48PF
description: RUCKUS ICX 7150-48PF stackable access switch: 48x 1G PoE+ RJ-45 (740 W budget), 2x 1G RJ-45 uplinks, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplink/stacking, 180 Gbps switching capacity.

poe.note: 48 PoE+ ports, 740 W budget - double the -48P, which is why the two must not be merged into one catalogue entry.

notes: Datasheet: 48+2 x 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ-45 PoE+, 48 PoE+ ports, 740 W PoE budget, 4x 1/10 GbE uplink/stacking ports. 740 W does not fund 48 ports at the 30 W Class 4 ceiling (that would be 1440 W); it funds all 48 at Class 3 with headroom. The technical specification page lists the -48PF among the models with two modular fan trays and two modular power supplies, and states fanless mode is not supported. Switching capacity 180 Gbps.
